item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: For a school science activity, Meena tests a spoonful of crushed groundnuts (peanuts) from her kitchen. The Biuret test turns purple and the food also leaves a greasy translucent patch on paper. What do these two results together show?

options.A: Groundnuts contain only proteins and no other nutrient.
options.B: One food item can contain more than one nutrient, since groundnuts show both proteins and fats.
options.C: The tests cancel each other, so groundnuts contain neither proteins nor fats.
options.D: Groundnuts contain only fats because the paper test is stronger than the Biuret test.
